identificationModule.briefTitle: First-line Treatment with RC48 Plus Tislelizumab and S-1(RCTS) in Advanced Gastric Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Prospective, Multicenter, Phase II Clinical Study of First-line Treatment for HER2 (human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2) Positive Advanced Gastric Cancer with Disitamab Vedotin in Combination with Tirelizumab and S-1

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a prospective, single arm, multicenter phase II study aimed at evaluating the efficacy and safety of Disitamab Vedotin in Combination With Tirelizumab and S-1 as first-line treatment for patients with advanced HER2-positive gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.

armGroups.label: RC48 Plus Tislelizumab and S-1(RCTS)
armGroups.description: Disitamab Vedotin: 2.5mg/kg, ivdrip, d1, (every 3 weeks) Q3W； Tislelizumab: 200mg, ivdrip, d1, (every 3 weeks) Q3W； S-1: 40-60mg(according to patients' body surface area), po, bid, d1-14 and discontinued for 7 days in each cycle; until progressive disease (PD) or intolerable toxicity

interventions.name: Disitamab vedotin
interventions.description: Disitamab Vedotin: 2.5mg/kg, d1, ivdrip, (every 3 weeks) Q3W

interventions.name: S1
interventions.description: S-1: 40-60mg (according to patients' body surface area), po, bid, d1-14, discontinued for 7 days.

primaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of subjects with complete response (CR) and partial response (PR) in total subjects
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 6 months after the last subject participating in

secondaryOutcomes.description: Progression-free survival (PFS per RECIST 1.1) is defined as the time from the starting date of study drug to the date of first documentation of disease progression or death, whichever occurs first
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 12 months after the last subject participating in

secondaryOutcomes.description: OS is defined as the time from the starting date of study drug to the date of death due to any cause.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 12 months after the last subject participating in

secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of subjects with complete response (CR) and partial response (PR) and stable disease(SD)in total subjects
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 12 months after the last subject participating in

secondaryOutcomes.description: DOR (per RECIST 1.1) is defined as the time from the date for first documented response of complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) to the date of first documented of disease progression or death, whichever occurs first.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 12 months after the last subject participating in
